entries.title: GRAD: Graph-Retrieved Adaptive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation

quotes.text: We evaluate GRAD across three challenging benchmarks: FaithEval (intrinsic consistency under noisy contexts), PreciseWikiQA (extrinsic factuality with graded difficulty), and WikiQA (truth-informativeness trade-off), using Qwen2.5 (1.5B/3B) and Llama3.2–3B.

entries.rationale: GRAD is evaluated on FaithEval as one of its three main benchmarks, with per-subset results — load-bearing use per rubric (evaluated-on with numbers).
